actions.label: Meet Hazel and the three friends

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: Welcome, Wayfinder! Tonight we hang lanterns for the Moonlight Gathering. First, meet three friends who might travel with you.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: I look for things that are hard to see. Sometimes I need help looking, too.

dialogue.speaker: Tansy
dialogue.text: I help growing things find room. Shall we leave room for each other?

dialogue.speaker: Nib
dialogue.text: I brought a plan. And a spare plan. You can help me choose!

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: Try each friend here. Nobody is being tested. Your travelling choice comes next.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: Pip tips a practice lantern until its reflection finds the chalk mark.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: A signature is one way to help. Focus always makes a little progress; rest brings energy back. You can borrow my tools in a trial.

dialogue.speaker: Tansy
dialogue.text: Tansy weaves loose stems around a practice hoop, leaving space for a tiny shoot.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: A signature is one way to help. Focus always makes a little progress; rest brings energy back. You can borrow my tools in a trial.

dialogue.speaker: Nib
dialogue.text: Nib steadies a wobbling practice stool, then invites you to move the brace.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: A signature is one way to help. Focus always makes a little progress; rest brings energy back. You can borrow my tools in a trial.

actions.label: Pack together with Hazel

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: Let’s plan a little journey together. I will help whenever you ask.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: Practice belongs to you. Helping together earns the same adventure reward.

actions.learning_context: Let’s pack for a little journey. Ask Hazel to help whenever you like.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: The bridge beacon! Its light has gone out.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: That brass cart is taking the east path. Come on, Moss—we can catch it!

dialogue.speaker: Moss
dialogue.text: First let’s check the crossing, Rowan.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: Moss is Rowan’s own mossback companion. The three friends you met still have homes here; nobody loses a friend because Rowan travels with Moss.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: We’ll see whose plan gets there first!

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: Look carefully before following. A good Wayfinder brings back what others missed.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: The storm split that old board. But look under it: these mounts have neat edges.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Something unscrewed the moonstones.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: And these brass curls match the cart. Let’s record both clues, without guessing the whole answer yet.

actions.label: Record the bridge evidence together

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: We know the bridge was damaged and the stones were removed. Those are two different things.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: A question can be a useful thing to bring along.

actions.learning_context: Look at the broken boards and the empty stone mounts. Let’s record what we noticed.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: Three fallen branches are marked beside the bank. Leave living branches on the tree.

dialogue.speaker: Nib
dialogue.text: We’ll reserve these for the crossing. Picnic supplies can wait.

actions.label: Plan the crossing with Hazel

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: Before we build, let’s work out the next small step together.

dialogue.speaker: Tansy
dialogue.text: I will wait while we make a plan that feels safe.

actions.learning_context: Before we build, let’s work out the next small step together. We can work it out together.

actions.label: Ask the woodcutter to cut three planks

dialogue.speaker: Woodcutter
dialogue.text: Three branches into three sound planks. I’ll do the cutting; you decide where they belong.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: Quest wood stays here until the crossing is ready.

actions.label: Lay the crossing with Hazel’s free braces

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: My braces are free to borrow. A Craft friend may steady one beside me; any friend can help with the crossing.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: Moss could hold all three!

dialogue.speaker: Moss
dialogue.text: One steady brace is a useful job.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: The planks are down. Now we must keep the crossing steady for the last traveller.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: Keep the braces steady until our traveller reaches this bank. See the next gust before you choose a move.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: You have three tool charges for this attempt. Focus, guard and rest are always available. Ask for a guided plan whenever you need one.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: The Bridge seal licenses your brace kit, and there is room for two friends on your travelling team.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: This little beacon lights the crossing again. It cannot draw back the light already locked at the Observatory.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The cart’s pipe is still humming.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: Its governor is set to Keep Filling. Someone must change that order. Meanwhile, the repaired local line keeps this bank safe.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: I’ll take the next trail. Moss and I won’t need a rest!

dialogue.speaker: Moss
dialogue.text: I would like one.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: The picnic camp is across the bridge. Rest is part of an expedition, too. Your second friendship invitation comes after the garden.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: Now that you have returned, try the narrow brace socket under the bank.

dialogue.speaker: Nib
dialogue.text: A friend can hold it, or the kit can. Both leave your hands free!

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: There are two dry leaves for making a shelter patch at camp—and a drawing of an island path.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: That island is still beyond the water. We need the ferry licence from Current before we can go there.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The little island has a broken beacon too.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel
dialogue.text: The current is too strong for wading. Mark it in your guide. We can return with the Current seal and a ferry or folding raft.

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: Both beds get the same water. The shaded bed is awake; the bed beside this new machine has closed its flowers.

dialogue.speaker: Tansy
dialogue.text: Its leaves are cool, but something is pulling at them.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The brass pipe is humming just like the one at the bridge.

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: Let’s compare what we can see before we move it.

actions.label: Record the garden comparison together

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: The machine is taking a light the roots need. More water alone cannot fix that.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: We can keep the seedlings safe while we find a way to stop the draught.

actions.learning_context: Look at the two garden beds. What can we find out together?

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: A winding border leaves little spaces for wandering flowers.

dialogue.speaker: Tansy
dialogue.text: There is room for a surprise in either garden.

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: Straight paths leave little spaces for new shoots beside each bed.

dialogue.speaker: Tansy
dialogue.text: There is room for a surprise in either garden.

actions.label: Shelter seedlings with Fern’s free seed frames

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: Tansy can weave a shelter if she is travelling with you. These free frames do the same essential job with any friend.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The seed beds are sheltered. The collector is still drawing at their roots.

actions.label: Prepare the garden together

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: Let’s check our garden plan before we face the draught.

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: You may ask for help. The garden needs a caring team, not a perfect test.

actions.learning_context: Let’s check our plan for keeping the seedlings safe.

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: Keep the shelter steady until the roots take hold. Watch the draught preview and choose who helps.

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: My three seed-tool charges are lent for every attempt. Retry or return to camp when you want to.

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: The garden beacon is flowing! Here are the Bloom seal and a free seed kit. You can open marked growth paths with a friend or the kit.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: There is a label under the collector: Temporary Emergency Reserve. Continue until central release.

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: The storm ended, but nobody sent the release. Our local bypass feeds the garden; the collector still sends its stored light uphill.

dialogue.speaker: Vell, through the cart speaker
dialogue.text: The Great Storm took our lamps once. My reserve will prevent it happening again. Do not disconnect the main pumps.

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: Warden, the roots were going dark.

dialogue.speaker: Vell, through the cart speaker
dialogue.text: I will inspect them after the reserve is full.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: We should bring him what we found.

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: Follow the old warning toward Echo next. First, one of the unchosen friends would like help making a resting place.

actions.label: Help Pip make a resting place

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: I found a sheltered place, but I cannot see the whole route to it. Will you help me leave clear markers?

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: We can do the little planning activity together, then invite your friend. Nib’s picnic invitation comes after Echo.

actions.learning_context: I found a sheltered place, but I cannot see the whole route to it. Will you help me leave clear markers? We can plan it together.

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: You may leave the invitation here until you feel ready.

dialogue.text: These rescued seedlings need a resting place with room to grow. Will you help me make it?

dialogue.text: The near arrow points toward the garden beds. Try the water when both arrows are set.

actions.label: Point the near channel toward the bypass

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: The bypass leads away from the beds and back to the bank. The marked route stays visible.

actions.label: Point the far channel toward the seedlings

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: The far arrow points toward the seedling shelter.

actions.label: Point the far channel toward the collector

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: The collector pipe leads uphill, away from the seedlings. You can change either handle before checking.

actions.label: Let the water flow and check both beds

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: Follow both arrows. Does water reach the garden and the seedlings? If one stays dry, change a handle and try again. There is no timer and nothing is used up.

actions.label: Close the water and reset both handles

dialogue.speaker: Fern
dialogue.text: Both handles return to their starting positions. You can try again together.

dialogue.speaker: Flutter
dialogue.text: Three little shakes. Then a pause. The tower is saying something.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: It sounds like an echo to me.

dialogue.speaker: Moss
dialogue.text: Flutter is showing where it comes from. Let’s look there.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The marks lead to a broken warning wire, not back into the hollow.

actions.label: Record the warning wire together

dialogue.speaker: Flutter
dialogue.text: Will you follow while I lead?

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Yes. We can leave pictures beside each mark so everyone can follow.

actions.learning_context: Follow Flutter’s picture marks and help record the warning.

dialogue.speaker: Orla
dialogue.text: This wooden cradle held the lighthouse lens. Stillworks moved it through the mill after the storm.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: I’ll copy its crescent stamp. We might need to find it later.

dialogue.speaker: Flutter
dialogue.text: The chimes are connected! The full message says: Storm ended. Stop collection. Open central release.

dialogue.speaker: Orla
dialogue.text: Keep the shutters open long enough to send the message. Your three tuning-tool charges are ready.

dialogue.speaker: Flutter
dialogue.text: A chime can help the next friend. We don’t all have to make the same move.

actions.label: Send the warning and wake Echo

dialogue.speaker: Orla
dialogue.text: The Echo seal opens the Orchard road. Your free tuning fork opens marked resonance locks.

dialogue.speaker: Vell, through the warning line
dialogue.text: I received your message. Collection will continue as a precaution.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Then the broken warning is not the only reason the collectors are running.

dialogue.speaker: Orla
dialogue.text: Take him the evidence of what they are costing us. The river and mill both need help; choose which to visit first.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: Moss and I will fix the river before anyone else arrives!

dialogue.speaker: Moss
dialogue.text: We should stop for a rest first, Rowan.

dialogue.text: I cannot see the whole route at once. Will you help mark a safe short path?

actions.label: Compare the mill ledger and waiting crates

dialogue.speaker: Cleo
dialogue.text: The deliveries arrived. The village stores are still empty.

dialogue.speaker: Bramble
dialogue.text: Every sealed crate is marked Observatory Reserve. I could carry them all back—

dialogue.speaker: Cleo
dialogue.text: Let’s find out why the sorter won’t release them before anyone carries everything.

actions.label: Record the redirected deliveries together

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Vell signed this: Keep packing after the storm until further notice.

dialogue.speaker: Cleo
dialogue.text: He knew the storm was over. We should keep that page safe.

actions.learning_context: Let’s look at the waiting crates and the village delivery list together.

actions.label: Recover the gear by the ridge

dialogue.speaker: Cleo
dialogue.text: The ridge trolley follows the marked level path. We will share the steadying handles.

dialogue.speaker: Bramble
dialogue.text: I will take one handle. Someone else can take the other.

actions.label: Recover the gear by the canal

dialogue.speaker: Cleo
dialogue.text: The mill’s short tow canal has a public hand winch. No ferry licence is needed on this enclosed towline.

dialogue.speaker: Bramble
dialogue.text: I will take one handle. Someone else can take the other.

actions.label: Fit the gear with Cleo and Bramble

dialogue.speaker: Cleo
dialogue.text: I was going to build the repair alone. Please hold this while I try the smaller pin.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: It does not have to be perfect on the first try.

dialogue.speaker: Cleo
dialogue.text: It fits. The sorter can turn again, but it still has the wrong order.

dialogue.speaker: Cleo
dialogue.text: First brace the sorter; then make room when the packing vines move. The affinity preview shows the change.

dialogue.speaker: Bramble
dialogue.text: The three borrowed tool charges stay with you through both phases.

actions.label: Open the mill for village deliveries

dialogue.speaker: Cleo
dialogue.text: The village crates are moving! This mill is a free rest and crafting camp again.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The lens ledger says Cove maintenance store. It matches the tower’s crescent stamp.

dialogue.speaker: Cleo
dialogue.text: Take a copy. Once both mill and river are safe, the Cove road can open.

dialogue.speaker: Bramble
dialogue.text: I would like a journey where we ask who wants each job, instead of choosing the heaviest one for me.

dialogue.speaker: Patter
dialogue.text: Leaves should float toward the landing. The pump is pulling them into the reserve instead.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: That is Rowan’s satchel beside the pump door.

dialogue.speaker: Moss, from inside
dialogue.text: Rowan, I need someone else to hold this gate.

actions.label: Plan the rescue with Patter

dialogue.speaker: Patter
dialogue.text: There is time to make a safe plan. My rope and the public prop are ready.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: First relieve Moss. Then we can work the marked valves.

actions.learning_context: Let’s make a safe plan to help Moss rest.

actions.label: Prop the gate and let Moss rest

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The public prop is in place. Moss, you can let go.

dialogue.speaker: Moss
dialogue.text: Thank you. I said I was tired, Rowan.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: I kept asking for one more try. I thought stopping would mean I had failed you.

dialogue.speaker: Moss
dialogue.text: Listening would have helped me more.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: We can rest, then find a job for each of us.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: I hear you. Moss gets to choose when he is ready.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: When Moss asks to stop, the plan needs to change.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: I hear you. Moss gets to choose when he is ready.

dialogue.speaker: Patter
dialogue.text: Keep the bypass steady while the landing fills. Use any friend and the three loan charges.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: I will watch the return path. You can come back to camp whenever you need.

actions.label: Restore the landing and ferry routes

dialogue.speaker: Patter
dialogue.text: The Current seal licences the ferry, and this free folding raft covers marked crossings too.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: I asked Reed whether she would like a job with us. She calls a rhythm; Moss chooses where to brace. Neither has to do everything.

dialogue.speaker: Moss
dialogue.text: And we all get to rest.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: We can finally return to the little island at the first bridge.

dialogue.speaker: Patter
dialogue.text: When both the river and mill are restored, Cove will be safe to reach.

actions.label: Read the first island’s beacon blueprint

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Eight grounded lines, one shared release. Each line has a different job.

dialogue.speaker: Hazel, in the field guide
dialogue.text: Bring the drawing along. There is another copy at the lighthouse, so no one must find this island to finish the journey.

actions.label: Compare glowing tracks and collector wheels

dialogue.speaker: Marina
dialogue.text: A bright visitor was here when the pools went dark. I wondered whether it took the light.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: These soft tracks go away from the intake. Brass wheel marks go straight to it.

dialogue.speaker: Luna
dialogue.text: My hand-lamp markers show a safe bank. Let’s follow the tracks without blaming whoever left them.

actions.label: Record the refuge evidence together

dialogue.speaker: Pebble
dialogue.text: The old tide mark is under water now. We should test it, not trust it only because it is old.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The bright visitor carried a stranded creature toward higher ground. The pipe took the light.

actions.learning_context: Let’s compare the tracks and pipes, then record what we found.

actions.label: Mark and open a safe overflow route

dialogue.speaker: Marina
dialogue.text: The public tide board shows this overflow reaches an empty pool, away from the nests.

dialogue.speaker: Pebble
dialogue.text: I will redraw the marker here. Anyone can use the marked hand gate; a Tide friend can help too.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The small creatures have a dry shelter. These brass covers match the garden collector.

dialogue.speaker: Marina
dialogue.text: I must correct what I said: we saw Glimmer here. We did not see Glimmer take the light.

dialogue.speaker: Marina
dialogue.text: First guide the water, then brace the refuge wall. Watch the changing affinity.

dialogue.speaker: Luna
dialogue.text: Three loan-tool charges and the camp path are ready. We can try again without losing the shelter.

dialogue.speaker: Marina
dialogue.text: The Tide line is grounded. Glimmer’s rescue tracks are clear for everyone to see.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The collector gauge is still rising. The light it already stored needs a way home.

dialogue.speaker: Marina
dialogue.text: This dry maintenance path reaches the lighthouse store. Sail can help you bring its lens back.

dialogue.speaker: Luna
dialogue.text: Glimmer went toward the hidden garden. When the central release is safe, perhaps we can follow.

actions.label: Match the lighthouse store’s crescent stamp

dialogue.speaker: Sail
dialogue.text: The stamp matches the tower cradle and the mill ledger. The lens is here, in the maintenance store.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: We have an ordinary hand lamp. We do not need Illuminate to get the lens.

dialogue.speaker: Sail
dialogue.text: Exactly. This wall diagram also shows eight grounded beacon lines, if you did not find the island copy.

actions.label: Trace the eight beacon lines together

dialogue.speaker: Sail
dialogue.text: Bridge supports, Bloom feeds, Echo times, Harvest measures, Current circulates, Tide takes overflow, Beacon directs, Accord shares control.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Seven local lines can bring us inside. The eighth must be connected at the Observatory before release.

actions.learning_context: Let’s follow each beacon line on the lighthouse diagram.

actions.label: Recover the lens by the ridge

dialogue.speaker: Sail
dialogue.text: The marked ridge has a level trolley rail. We can stop at each rest mark.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The lens is in its cradle. We can carry it together on the public trolley.

actions.label: Recover the lens by the tunnel

dialogue.speaker: Sail
dialogue.text: The maintenance tunnel has wide handrails and hand lamps. Nothing here requires Illuminate.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The lens is in its cradle. We can carry it together on the public trolley.

actions.label: Fit the recovered lens into the lighthouse

dialogue.speaker: Reed
dialogue.text: I will call our walking rhythm. Moss, do you want the back handle?

dialogue.speaker: Moss
dialogue.text: Yes, until the next rest mark.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: Then we stop there and ask again.

dialogue.speaker: Sail
dialogue.text: I want a place on this expedition, too. I can guide the trolley instead of only cheering.

dialogue.speaker: Sail
dialogue.text: The lens is recovered. Now hold its direction against the shutters to earn Illuminate.

dialogue.speaker: Sail
dialogue.text: My three alignment-tool charges work before the reward is earned.

actions.label: Turn the lighthouse toward the Observatory

dialogue.speaker: Sail
dialogue.text: The Beacon seal licenses Illuminate. Here is a free lantern for every marked light passage.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The beam shows a maintenance ascent around Vell’s locked front gate.

dialogue.speaker: Luna
dialogue.text: I can be afraid and still guide a little part. The public lantern trail will guide anyone who needs it.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: Moss, Reed and I will keep the way back open.

actions.label: Present the accumulated evidence to Vell

dialogue.speaker: Vell
dialogue.text: During the Great Storm I held a lamp that would not light. I will not let that happen again.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The mounts were removed. The roots closed. You received the stop warning, and you signed the order to keep filling.

dialogue.speaker: Vell
dialogue.text: The reserve is almost ready.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Its pressure is rising too. People and habitats are going without the light already here.

actions.label: Plan the shared return together

dialogue.speaker: Vell
dialogue.text: Opening one pipe would send too much light down one route.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The old diagram has eight grounded lines. Our seven repaired local lines can share the return. We need the central Accord line too.

actions.learning_context: Let’s plan how to share the light safely between every region.

actions.label: Ask Vell to recognise the harm

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: The garden cannot wait for the reserve to feel full.

dialogue.speaker: Vell
dialogue.text: I can see the garden signal. I kept taking because I was afraid to have too little.

actions.label: Ask Vell to look at the garden

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Look at Fern’s live signal with us. The roots are flickering again.

dialogue.speaker: Vell
dialogue.text: I can see the garden signal. I kept taking because I was afraid to have too little.

dialogue.text: Who is the reserve protecting if everyone below it has too little?

dialogue.speaker: Vell
dialogue.text: I can see the garden signal. I kept taking because I was afraid to have too little.

actions.label: Reconnect the seven repaired local lines

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Bridge, Bloom, Echo, Harvest, Current, Tide, Beacon: every repaired place has a job on this panel.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: Reed is marking the exit. Moss is bracing one gate. I am checking the rest route with them.

dialogue.speaker: Vell
dialogue.text: I locked the main control. There is a manual crank, but I must stop filling before you can use it.

actions.label: Open the central Accord line with Vell

dialogue.speaker: Vell
dialogue.text: Here is the crank. I am changing the order: stop filling. Let us share control.

dialogue.speaker: Player
